name: record_interpretation
arguments: {"test_id": "T1", "per_hypothesis": [{"id": "H1", "verdict": "weakened", "why": "T1 verdict no_ligand_contact: residue 211 was not within 4.5 \u00c5 of any non-solvent ligand in 3IAR (3D1, NI) or 7RTG (ZN); contacts with residue 211 = 0 for all three ligands, min distance null. Both structures observed residue 211, so the absence is not a missing-density artefact. This removes the direct structural support for a ligand-contact mechanism (E14, E16). Not refuted: the would_refute criterion also required a modelled R211H ligand-bound complex showing no change in ligand contact or binding energy, which T1 did not run, and the test used 4.5 \u00c5 rather than the ~5 \u00c5 in the criterion."}, {"id": "H2", "verdict": "unchanged", "why": "T1 is a ligand-contact test and does not measure side-chain packing, folding free energy or solubility. It neither supports nor weakens H2. H2 remains untested; its residue-level support (E5 beta strand 210-219, E17 pLDDT 96.56, E7 AlphaMissense 0.5475, E10 popEVE -3.678, E12 EVE 0.837) is computational and unchanged by this result."}, {"id": "H3", "verdict": "unchanged", "why": "T1 does not test inter-chain contacts or interface membership. The fact that residue 211 is observed in 3IAR and 7RTG is not evidence of an interface, and the interface state for residue 211 is not_covered. H3 remains untested."}], "uncertainty": "T1 checked only two ligand-bound structures (3IAR with 3D1 and NI; 7RTG with ZN), both of which are soluble analogues and crystal environments, not measurements of binding by the variant. Absence of a ligand in these structures does not show absence of binding in the native enzyme, and there is no ligand-bound R211H structure. Controls: the negative control ligands (3D1, NI, ZN) never contacted 211; neighbour counts (13 for 3D1, 4 for NI and ZN) show the test was not dominated by a large neighbour list; no structure carried the residue mutated. Still needed: a modelled R211H complex with the substrate/analogue (to test the refutation clause for H1), and a folding/stability (T2) and interface (T3) test for H2 and H3. The 4.5 \u00c5 cutoff versus ~5 \u00c5 in the H1 criterion is a minor difference that does not change the verdict.\""}

name: record_decision
arguments: {"favoured_after": "H2", "why": "Previous favourite H1 (ligand_binding, starting rank 1) is weakened by T1 (no_ligand_contact: 0 contacts of residue 211 within 4.5 \u00c5 of 3D1, NI or ZN across 3IAR and 7RTG; E14, E16). Its remaining support (E9, E11) is literature on ADA activity that does not name R211H, and E2 and E8 are clinical or conservation evidence that does not discriminate mechanism, so H1 has no direct residue-specific support left. Strongest rival H2 (stability_folding, rank 2) has residue-specific computational evidence that T1 did not touch: E5 places R211 in a beta strand (210-219), E17 pLDDT 96.56 on the AlphaFold model, E7 AlphaMissense 0.5475 (ambiguous), E10 popEVE -3.678, E12 EVE 0.837 (pathogenic). H2 is not confirmed: it has no measured stability value yet. H3 (protein_interaction, rank 3) has no residue-specific support beyond residue 211 being observed in the crystal structures (E14, E16), and its interface state is not_covered. H2 is therefore the best-supported mechanism now, provisionally, pending T2."}
